'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Charley Joe LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Charley Joe]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This]]
* '''Username:''' Wburg
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
